subject: SIG intake: vulnerability evidence crosswalk, exception ledger, and DocuSign request
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@harborpay.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake - VM cadence and exception ledger request

Hi Aditya / Redwood team,

We're kicking off the SIG intake for HarborPay and need a focused vulnerability management evidence packet to attach to our SIG questionnaire. Specifically we need: 
- A crosswalk that maps Redwood's scan cadence (dynamic + scheduled), scan types (authenticated/unauthenticated), and retention window to SIG/CSSM controls (CAIQ-friendly).
- The exception ledger (all approved exceptions impacting production in the last 90 days) with owner and review cadence.
- A CVE closure log for any CVEs remediated in the last 120 days with timestamps (reported -> triaged -> patch deployed -> verified).
- Your standard SLAs for Critical/High/Medium classifications and the emergency patch process (change window expectations).
- A signed attestation letter confirming the above for our SOC2/SIG intake (we will run this as part of audit intake).

Do you have a template crosswalk and can you confirm whether the evidence will be scoped to production only (we ask for prod in us-east-1)? We need the packet and the signed DocuSign by EOD Sep 24 to meet our audit calendar.

Thanks,
Emily Carter
Security Intake Lead, HarborPay
emily.carter@harborpay.com
Audit Team: audit-team@harborpay.com

(Attachments requested: CSV export for exception ledger and CVE closure log, PDF attestation)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@harborpay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake - VM cadence and exception ledger request

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask. We can pull together exactly what you requested and sign an attestation via DocuSign. Proposed plan: 

1) Evidence crosswalk (PDF) mapping Redwood scan cadence + types to SIG/CAIQ control IDs.
2) Exported CSVs: exception ledger (last 90 days) and CVE closure log (last 120 days) with UTC timestamps and ticket links.
3) Scan cadence export (CSV) showing scheduled jobs, dynamic scans, and retention policy.
4) SOP document for emergency/accelerated patches and the change-window process.
5) Signed attestation (DocuSign) that summarizes SLAs and confirms the evidence exports.

Clarifying Q: Is the scope strictly production in us-east-1 as you noted, or do you want a combined prod+staging package? Also, for the SLA ask, our standard remediation targets are Critical: 14 days, High: 30 days, Medium: 90 days — happy to include that in the attestation. If HarborPay requires a different SLA (e.g., High = 30 days specifically called out), we can include a written exception process and sign-off.

I'll pull the crosswalk draft and the CSV exports and loop Laura for the attestation sign-off. Expect the first draft tomorrow EOD.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
(Attachment: vm_crosswalk-outline.pdf)

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@harborpay.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Audit Team <audit-team@harborpay.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake - VM cadence and exception ledger request

Thanks Aditya — scope: production systems in us-east-1 only. Retention: we need 12 months of evidence for both the exception ledger and CVE closure log.

A few clarifications: 
- We will accept your standard SLAs but HarborPay procurement asks that High be explicitly stated as 30 days (sounds like we're aligned there).
- For emergency patches that require immediate change-window deviations, please include any historical examples in the SOP (one or two short summaries will suffice).
- Audit day POC: please provide a named contact who can join our audit call if reviewers have follow‑up questions.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sep 24 EOD is firm for our intake.

Emily
